about: Maps each id of indicadores.json (Portuguese, written before the v1 integration) to the id Canary uses. kind: 'indicator' (catalog.INDICATORS), 'lab' (a blood or urine row in data/recipes.json, read by the risks), 'risk' (a risk in risk.py, no indicator of its own), 'none' (Canary has nothing for it yet). Only the texts of the guide are meant for the app (como_medir, efeito_no_espaco, acoes); every number Canary uses comes from reference.py and standards.py.

pa_sistolica.note: Canary's sbp is the systolic pressure (the old bp).

potassio.note: Blood panel, real Inspiration4 values (OSD-575); read by the cardio risk.

calcio.note: Blood panel (OSD-575); read by the renal risk.

exercicio.note: Canary compares with the day's plan for the place (EXERCISE_BY_PLACE).

radiacao_carreira.note: Career dose in the radiation risk (dose.career_msv), NASA-STD-3001 V1 4030.

radiacao_evento_solar.note: The storm evidence of the radiation risk and the storm alert, V1 4031.

vitamina_d.note: Simulated row only; no indicator or limit in Canary.

vo2max.note: NASA limit by place and EVA role in standards.py.

forca_muscular.note: Grip strength stands in for whole-body strength (V1 4024).

densidade_ossea_quadril_coluna.note: Canary's bone row is an estimate held to the 95% hip and spine line (V1 4027).

densidade_ossea_colo_femur.note: Canary has one bone estimate, held to the hip and spine line.

ingestao_calorica.note: No food log yet (V1 4020 is in standards.NOT_CHECKED).

radiacao_30_dias.note: Organ dose in mGy-Eq cannot be compared with the effective dose Canary has (standards.NOT_CHECKED).
